finalText: All 5 tests pass. The bug was in `computeTotal` in `src/services/pricing.js:9` — flat coupons are stored in USD, but the code was subtracting the raw USD amount from the *already-converted* total (e.g. subtracting $10 from a €90 total). I fixed it to subtract the flat coupon in USD before converting to the target currency, so a $10 discount correctly becomes €9 off, not €10 off.
